subject: Galactic Bank: Data lifecycle attestation and escrow/geo-hold Q&A
messages:
From: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@galacticbank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@galacticbank.com, security.ops@galacticbank.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Request: evidence for TTL/deletion, geo-hold and escrow process (SOC 2 / ISO)

Hi Marissa / Vivek,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call today. As part of our legal and SOC 2 review we need a concise packet of evidence related to Galactic Bank tenant data lifecycle policies. Specifically we need:

- Formal attestation that tenant data TTLs are enforced and where the enforcement occurs (serving runtime, storage tier, backups).
- Evidence of deletion traces (audit logs) and sampling guidance used to validate erasures.
- Process for placing a geo-hold / legal hold and any impact to retention TTLs.
- Escrow or disaster-recovery process for long-term access to tenant state (what is retained, for how long, and how it is accessed).

Can you provide a short attestation document + the key artifacts (runbook excerpt, sample erasure log, escrow summary)? We aim to include these in our ISO evidence package by next Friday.

Thanks,
Anna
Anna Lopez
Head of Vendor Risk, Galactic Bank

P.S. If there are any known SLA exceptions or TTL exemptions (e.g., backups retained longer for compliance), please call them out explicitly.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@galacticbank.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: evidence for TTL/deletion, geo-hold and escrow process (SOC 2 / ISO)

Hi Anna —

Thanks for the list. We can provide an attestation and a compact evidence packet targeted at SOC 2/ISO auditors. High level:

- TTL enforcement: tenant object TTLs are enforced at storage layer (object lifecycle) and at the runtime cache eviction boundary for KV caches. TTLs are configurable per-tenant; default retention is 90 days for non-sensitive test data and 365 days for production tenant artifacts unless otherwise contracted.
- Deletion traces: we retain audit traces of deletion requests and job run outcomes for 180 days by default; these include job IDs, worker node IDs, object keys, hex-hash snapshots, and a deletion result code.
- Backups & exemptions: backups (nightly snapshots) are retained for 45 days by default; we can configure extended backup retention for customers with longer retention commitments. Backups are marked in the audit index and are excluded from immediate TTL-driven erasure until the backup TTL expires.
- Geo-hold: our Geo-Hold runbook pauses TTL workflows for the affected tenant and creates a locked snapshot; geo-hold can be scoped to tenant or object path. Locked snapshots are stored encrypted and indexed with the hold ticket ID.
- Escrow: for enterprise customers we offer an escrow snapshot export process (encrypted bundle + signed manifest) delivered under an escrow contract; summary doc attached.

I'll attach: redwood_ttl_attestation.pdf (formal attestation), geo_hold_runbook.md (excerpts), escrow-process-summary.pdf, and a sanitized sample deletion log. Rishi will follow up with detail on sampling methodology and auditor playback steps.

Next steps: I can deliver the attestation + artifacts today, and schedule a 30-min call to walk your auditors through the playback. Does Thurs Apr 15 10:00–11:00 PT work?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Compliance & Customer Trust
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_ttl_attestation.pdf (PDF, 28KB), geo_hold_runbook.md (MD, 9KB), escrow-process-summary.pdf (PDF, 15KB)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@galacticbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: evidence for TTL/deletion, geo-hold and escrow process (SOC 2 / ISO)

Hi Anna — quick technical clarifications to help scope the evidence packet: 

1) Scope: Do you want evidence for production tenant IDs only, or also staging/test tenants? (We usually limit audit exports to production tenant IDs to avoid PII mixing.)
2) Backups: Are you expecting backup-era deletion proofs (i.e., deletion traces showing that data was removed from the primary store, plus a policy note about backups being retained until backup TTL)? Our standard approach is to provide primary-store erasure logs plus a manifest showing backup retention windows.
3) Sampling size: Our sampling playbook picks 3 random days across the retention window and provides proof-of-deletion artifacts for those dates; auditors often accept this since it demonstrates pipeline behavior. If you need full-coverage proof, we will need a scoped engagement.

If you confirm production-only and that sampling is acceptable, we can prepare the sanitized logs + run the auditor walkthrough on Thu Apr 15 10:00 PT.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Product Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: sanitized-deletion-sample.csv (CSV, 12KB)

From: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@galacticbank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: evidence for TTL/deletion, geo-hold and escrow process (SOC 2 / ISO)

Marissa / Vivek —

Thanks, that sounds good. Confirming:

- Scope: production tenants only (Galactic Bank production tenant IDs will be provided in a separate secured spreadsheet).
- Sampling: acceptable — please provide the 3-day sampling artifacts and deletion traces for those days.
- Backups: provide backup retention manifest and note that backup snapshots are excluded from immediate TTL deletion until their snapshot TTL passes.

We also need a signed attestation (PDF) we can include in our evidence pack and a DocuSign link for formal acceptance. Can you prepare the signed attestation and send the DocuSign envelope?

We are targeting our internal ISO evidence deadline next Friday Apr 23.

Best,
Anna

Attachment: scope_tenant_list.xlsx (we will send via secure SFTP), request-reference: HB-2027-41

Anna —

I've created a DocuSign envelope for signature acceptance: https://app.docusign.com/recipient/embedded?envelopeId=1234-GB-ATTEST (link above also included in metadata).

- sanitized-deletion-sample.csv: three sampling days with job IDs and deletion result codes (PII removed).
- backup-retention-manifest.csv: nightly snapshot retention windows and expirations.
- geo_hold_runbook.md: excerpt showing the steps to place/release a hold and associated ticketing.
- escrow-process-summary.pdf: summary of escrow export packaging and chain-of-custody steps.

If you'd like, Rishi can run the auditor playback during the scheduled call on Apr 15 (I realize the date is in the past — typo on the draft invite; let's move the walkthrough to Tue Apr 20 10:00–10:30 PT). Please confirm and we'll send the calendar invite and DocuSign envelope for acceptance.

Best regards,
Marissa Cole

Redwood Inference
